description: Valid and invalid cases for every schema of superbench.local-api but the remote credential (remote-credentials.json), each decided by the schema alone. A case labelled as in a source corpus is that corpus entry, byte for byte; the rest are written from SuperBench's Go parsers (the superbench: sources). Semantic and lexical refusals stay in the corpora and their own tests.
